title: 'Undeniable': New Bigfoot files include alleged footprint photos
excerpt: After the federal government released a new batch of Bigfoot files, a self-proclaimed tracker and researcher says it’s “becoming undeniable” that the creature exists.
content:
[Editor’s Note: The video above is previous coverage on this story.]

(NewsNation) — After the federal government released a new batch of Bigfoot files, a self-proclaimed tracker and researcher says it’s “becoming undeniable” that the creature exists.

Last week, the U.S. Forest Service quietly released three files related to the legendary Pacific Northwest cryptid known as Bigfoot. One file dates back to 1982 and includes photographs of alleged footprints, along with measurements, descriptions and notes from a wildlife biologist.

A second file included a newspaper article on Bigfoot and the third is an account of Petty Creek, Montana. In the information about Petty Creek, the author describes a 1941 encounter with a “creature that walked on its hind legs” and left tracks in the woods.

Appearing on “Jesse Weber Live,” Charles Stuart, known as “Snake the Bigfoot Hunter,” stated his steadfast belief in Bigfoot mirrors the skepticism that once surrounded UFOs before more information became publicly available.

“There’s just too many eyewitnesses, too much documentation,” he said. “And with this body I have, it’s pretty hard to refute that this is happening. So I think it’s all being pushed forward to kind of prime the pump for everyone.”

Stuart added that he had heard the U.S. Forest Service took its time before releasing the files, a delay he suggested has fueled speculation among Bigfoot believers.

“There’s other investigations that have happened,” he noted. “This is an ongoing thing. They’re only allowing those few things out there right now, but this is an ongoing thing for sure.”

“I think a lot of the reports that they don’t want out there are actually tied to missing persons and some type of tragedies that have happened that they haven’t really applied the same rigor to in terms of investigating. They can’t put it out there publicly, so they’re only giving us some morsels right now.”

Stories of Bigfoot date back to indigenous legends, although the creature, also known as Sasquatch, came to widespread notoriety in the 1950s.

Believers have long searched for evidence of the seven-foot-tall, hairy, ape-like creature and one of the released files documents alleged Bigfoot prints.

NewsNation’s Steph Whiteside contributed to this report.
